messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — Elevated 5xx error rate observed for /v1/generate and /v1/chat in us-west-2. Error rate = 7.2% over 5m window. Triggered at 2026-09-14T14:45:23Z (thread 1782101123). Pager routed to maya (oncall).

maya (oncall): Ack — looking now. grabbing logs and metrics. @chris - infra can you join for cloud-side checks? :rotating_light:

chris - infra: I'm in. Control plane looks healthy. Frontend -> model-host pool shows elevated 5xx from grpc proxy. Opening vendor escalation with AWS networking. @sam can you prepare a fallback routing so we can reduce error volume?

sam - sde: On it. Preparing routing override to fallback model (sm-small-q). Command I'm running:

```
/api/admin/routing override --route /v1/generate --model sm-small-q --timeout 30s
```

Applying override now (will ramp 10% -> 100%).

inc-bot: Routing override applied: sm-small-q (rolled to 100% over 2m).

maya (oncall): Observing immediate drop in errors to baseline after override, but occasional spikes persist. We should escalate to cloud provider for possible fabric/packet-drop issue. @jules can you draft a customer status and internal comms? Keep wording conservative (degraded performance).

jules - customer ops: Drafting — please review: 

Customer-facing (short):
"We are investigating intermittent elevated error rates for text generation in us-west-2. Traffic is being routed to a fallback model; some requests may experience increased latency. No data loss. We will post updates every 30 minutes."

natalie - eng-manager: SGTM. Please add impacted endpoints (/v1/generate, /v1/chat) and call out mitigation (routing override + AZ canary).

jules - customer ops: Updated draft. Will hold for legal review then publish. Posting draft link to internal docs: docs/internal/drafts/incident-1782101123.md. @maya please confirm when we should publish.

maya (oncall): Publish now. I'm calling AWS support (Severity 1). Opening case and attaching logs. Case created: AWS case 3487123.

chris - infra: Debug notes — seeing high TCP retransmits between frontends and GPU hosts. Capturing packet trace:

```
tcpdump -i eth0 'host 10.0.5.21 and port 443' -c 200 -w /tmp/pcap.pcap
```

Uploading pcap to the AWS case.

aws-support-bot: Case 3487123 created and assigned to AWS Eng Escalation Team. Initial ack ETA ~15m.

sam - sde: Status update — fallback model scaled, errors down to ~0.8% (from 7.2%). Latency p50 up ~120ms. Keeping fallback active recommended for 1h while AWS investigates.

maya (oncall): Agree. @jules send the customer notification and include enterprise contact instructions.

jules - customer ops: Customer email template (ready to send):

Hi <Customer>,

We experienced intermittent elevated error rates affecting text generation endpoints in us-west-2 starting at 2026-09-14 14:45 UTC. We routed traffic to a fallback model and are actively investigating with our infrastructure provider. During mitigation, some requests may have increased latency or receive the fallback model. No data was lost. We will provide further updates within 60 minutes or on new findings.

Sincerely,
Redwood Inference Ops Team

Would you like any enterprise-specific language added?

maya (oncall): Add: 'Contact your CSM or support@redwood.ai and include incident 1782101123' and send to affected customers.

jules - customer ops: Sent to affected customers and posted an initial 'Investigating' update to status.redwood.ai/incidents/1782101123.

aws-support-bot: Escalation update — AWS networking Eng confirms reproducible packet drops inside AWS fabric. Internal ticket 89234 opened. Suggested workaround: reroute traffic to alternate AZs while fix is deployed. Please provide affected ENI list.

chris - infra: Sharing ENIs: eni-0a12b, eni-0f9c3, eni-0d2a1. Uploaded to AWS case 3487123.

maya (oncall): We can attempt an AZ failover for a small canary. @sam please run a 5% AZ routing switch to test.

sam - sde: Starting canary now. Command:

```
kubectl patch svc redwood-api -n prod -p '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Local"}}'
```

Monitoring canary.

inc-bot: Canary AZ switch executed. 5% traffic moved to us-west-2b.

sam - sde: Canary looks good — errors at 0% for canary traffic. Increasing to 25% now.

chris - infra: If canary holds, plan to shift remainder of traffic over next 10m. AWS has asked us to proceed cautiously until they confirm fabric fix.

maya (oncall): Update status page to: 'Mitigation in progress — routing to fallback model + AZ reroute for subset of traffic.' We'll update again in 30m.

jules - customer ops: Internal comms template (for GTM and support):

Subject: Incident 1782101123 - us-west-2 serving degradation (P1)

TL;DR: Intermittent 5xx spikes on /v1/generate and /v1/chat in us-west-2. Mitigation: routing override to fallback model + AZ canary reroute. Impact window: ~14:45-15:05 UTC, partially mitigated. Next steps: coordinate with AWS, monitor, post RCA.

Please avoid reaching out to customers directly unless you are listed as CSM or on-call.

Contacts: maya (oncall), chris (infra), jules (customer ops).

natalie - eng-manager: Looping in Sales leadership and CSMs now.

aws-support-bot: Update from AWS — fix being rolled out to affected fabric; expected normalization in 30-45 minutes. Case will remain open until verified.

maya (oncall): Great — maintain fallback and AZ routing until AWS confirms. I'll start an RCA skeleton in docs/incidents/1782101123 and assign owners for root cause, timeline, and customer impact.

jules - customer ops: Will post final customer note once AWS confirms stabilization. Thanks all for rapid ops. :heart:
